title: Social status and Holocaust survival in Nazi internment

abstract: This paper examines the intergenerational effects of the Food Stamp Program (FSP) on fertility and marriage in the United States. Using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we leverage the initial roll-out of the Food Stamp Program in the 1960s and 1970s to examine the future family formation decisions of individuals born between 1955 and 1981. The results suggest that exposure to the program has different effects on fertility and marriage based on age and gender. For men, increased exposure to the program reduces fertility at older ages, particularly for those from disadvantaged backgrounds, with limited effects on marriage. Among women, we find no statistically significant effects of increased exposure to FSP on fertility and marriage. Our study builds on a growing literature that considers the intergenerational impacts of public policies that increase childhood economic resources.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国食品券计划（FSP）对生育与婚姻的代际影响。利用收入动态面板研究数据，我们借助20世纪60年代和70年代食品券计划的初始推行，探讨了1955年至1981年间出生个体未来的家庭组建决策。结果表明，该计划的暴露程度对生育和婚姻的影响因年龄和性别而异。对于男性而言，增加计划暴露会降低其较大年龄时的生育率，尤其是对来自不利背景的男性，而对婚姻的影响有限。在女性中，我们发现增加FSP暴露对生育和婚姻无统计学上显著的影响。本研究丰富了日益增长的文献，这些文献关注增加童年经济资源的公共政策所产生的代际影响。
title: The intergenerational effect of the Food Stamp Program on marriage and fertility
title_zh: 食品券计划对婚姻与生育的代际影响

abstract: This paper provides direct evidence that shared incarceration can facilitate the formation of post-release criminal partnerships. Using Norwegian administrative data linking prison spells to police case identifiers, we measure network ties through subsequent co-offending. We exploit time-based variation in exposure within facilities by comparing inmate pairs in the same facility who differ only in whether their spells overlapped. Overlap is associated with a 37% increase in five-year co-offending relative to comparable non-overlapping pairs, robust to extensive controls and timing-based restrictions. Effects are stronger in environments and for pairs where interaction is plausibly more intense, highlighting network formation as a plausible mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了直接证据，表明共同监禁经历可能促进释放后犯罪伙伴关系的形成。利用挪威行政数据，将监狱服刑期与警方案件标识符相链接，我们通过后续共同犯罪来衡量网络联系。我们利用设施内接触时间上的变化，比较同一设施中仅在服刑期是否重叠上有所不同的囚犯配对。与可比的非重叠配对相比，重叠配对五年内共同犯罪率增加了37%，这一结果在广泛的控制变量和基于时间的限制条件下依然稳健。在互动强度可能更高的环境及配对中，效应更为显著，凸显了网络形成作为一种合理解释机制。
title: From prison peers to co-offenders

abstract: How large is the labour cost saved by AI, and how is it distributed across occupations? Using five waves of the Anthropic Economic Index from January 2025 to February 2026, this column constructs two novel measures from observed AI usage across countries over the world. The labour cost equivalent values the time currently saved by AI at $2.7 trillion annually (3.4% of GDP), concentrated in a small professional enclave in developing economies, with concentration declining in many countries.
abstract_zh: 人工智能节省的劳动力成本规模有多大，其在不同职业间的分布如何？利用2025年1月至2026年2月间五轮Anthropic经济指数数据，本文基于全球各国观察到的AI使用情况，构建了两个新颖的衡量指标。劳动力成本等值将当前AI节省的时间估值每年达2.7万亿美元（占GDP的3.4%），集中于发展中经济体的一个小型专业领域，且在许多国家中，这种集中度正在下降。
title: AI’s gains are large and rising, but unevenly shared
title_zh: 人工智能收益巨大且持续增长，但分配不均

abstract: Autocratic regimes shape what citizens know through censorship and propaganda, but their priorities are rarely observable at scale. This column exploits the 2023 cloning of Russian-language Wikipedia and its subsequent rewriting into Ruwiki, a regime-aligned alternative. Comparing the two 1.9 million-article corpora reveals a coherent editorial intervention legitimising Russia’s aggression, suppressing opposition and criticism of state institutions, and promoting traditional values. Rewriting is far more common than outright deletion, suggesting that modern information control works primarily by changing the meaning of familiar topics rather than making them disappear.
abstract_zh: 专制政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的认知，但其优先事项在宏观层面往往难以观察。本文利用2023年俄语维基百科的克隆及其随后被改写为亲政权的替代平台Ruwiki这一事件，比较了两个各含190万篇文章的语料库，揭示出一场连贯的编辑干预，旨在为俄罗斯的侵略行为赋予合法性，压制反对声音及对国家机构的批评，并推广传统价值观。改写远比直接删除更为普遍，这表明现代信息控制主要通过改变熟悉话题的含义来运作，而非使其消失。
authors: Ekaterina Zhuravskaya, Ulrich Matter, Ruben Durante, Vladimir Avetian
title: The anatomy of censorship and propaganda: What Russia’s Wikipedia clone reveals about authoritarian information control
title_zh: 审查与宣传的解剖：俄罗斯维基百科克隆版揭示的威权信息控制
